recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; no core source follow-up is needed unless the Financial Management work group opens a new issue to change the location or wording of the existing excluded elements.
issue_request: FHIR-11386 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Financial Management change request from the DSTU2 ballot asking for a 0..1 boolean negation indicator on EligibilityResponse benefits to indicate that a benefit is not covered under the plan; the final resolution said to add excluded 0..1 boolean to EligibilityResponse and EOB.
initial_application: No current history commit message explicitly names FHIR-11386, but commit d1be564fe0a5fed4f38a2dbb1b4f5fc16f106a20 added excluded boolean rows to the legacy EligibilityResponse and ExplanationOfBenefit spreadsheets. Commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 later migrated the retained elements into the current StructureDefinition source files.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists CoverageEligibilityResponse and ExplanationOfBenefit as active resources and maps the old EligibilityResponse name to CoverageEligibilityResponse. FHIR-11396 is the companion EOB issue with the same change family and is already represented on the combined branch, so it was not republished.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active StructureDefinitions already contain CoverageEligibilityResponse.insurance.item.excluded and ExplanationOfBenefit.benefitBalance.excluded as 0..1 boolean elements with excluded-from-plan semantics.

related_jiras.note: Companion EOB negation-indicator issue with the same expanded resolution; already audited on the combined branch as d17e50d2e9b565e3bfb5769b93ca877742872b9b and therefore not republished.
